title: BLACK KNIFE
body:
This mod adds multiple items from DELTARUNE by Toby Fox, including:

The **Shadow Crystal**

Recipe:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![Shadow Crystal Recipe: one Echo Shard surrounded by Tinted Glass.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/950c3c800404f5fa8b2264dbcdae4e1213d07d13.png)

</details>

This item finally puts another use to those stupid _Echo Shards_ you find in the ancient cities. This item, on its own, does nothing special, but you will need them to craft the next item:

The **Pure Crystal**

Recipe:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![Pure Crystal Recipe: 5 Shadow Crystals in a plus shape.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c5015768d76e2d3725b182d9531d3c3d272920e.png)

</details>

This item acts as a strong weapon, just like the "Black Shard" in DELTARUNE (that item is not in this mod). You can only use it 32 times though, so you better save it to craft the next item:

The **Black Knife**

Recipe:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![Black Knife Recipe: a Netherite Sword upgraded with a Pure Crystal in a Smithing Table.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/207beaf8729fc5b401270c1ff17441f036b5561a.png)

</details>

This is an extremely OP weapon, able to deal 55 attack damage, and has very high durability. It can be repaired using more Shadow Crystals.

Mod made by me (Noellevox) using MCreator.
